Privacy Policy
Last updated 21st September, 2026
We Commit To:
We will not:
• Collect, maintain, use or share Student PII beyond that needed for authorized educational/school purposes, or as
authorized by the parent/student.
• Sell student PII.
• Use or disclose student information collected through an educational/school service (whether personal information or
otherwise) for behavioral targeting of advertisements to students.
• Build a personal profile of a student other than for supporting authorized educational/school purposes or as authorized
by the parent/student.
• Make material changes to School Service Provider education privacy policies without first providing prominent notice
to the users and/or account holder(s) (i.e., the institution/agency, or the parent/student when the information is collected
directly from the student with student/parent consent) and allowing them choices before data is used in any manner
inconsistent with terms they were initially provided; and not make material changes to other policies or practices
governing the use of Student PII that are inconsistent with contractual requirements.
• Knowingly retain Student PII beyond the time period required to support the authorized educational/school purposes,
or as authorized by the parent/student.
We will:
• Collect, use, share, and retain Student PII only for purposes for which we were authorized by the educational
institution/agency, teacher or the parent/student.
• Disclose clearly in contracts or privacy policies, including in a manner easy for institutions and parents to find and
understand, what types of Student PII we collect, if any, and the purposes for which the information we maintain is used
or shared with third parties.
• Support access to and correction of Student PII by the student or their authorized parent, either by assisting the
educational institution in meeting its requirements or directly when the information is collected directly from the student
with student/parent consent.
• Maintain a comprehensive security program that is reasonably designed to protect the security, confidentiality, and
integrity of Student PII against risks, such as unauthorized access or use, or unintended or inappropriate disclosure,
through the use of administrative, technological, and physical safeguards appropriate to the sensitivity of the information.
• Provide resources to support educational institutions/agencies, teachers, or parents/students to protect the security
and privacy of Student PII while using the educational service.
• Require that our vendors with whom Student PII is shared in order to deliver the educational service, if any, are
obligated to follow these same commitments for the given Student PII.
• Allow a successor entity to maintain the Student PII, in the case of our merger or acquisition by another entity,
provided the successor entity is subject to these same commitments for the previously collected Student PII.
• Incorporate privacy and security when developing or improving our educational products, tools, and services and
comply with applicable laws.

Introduction
CoGrader ("we," "us," or "our") is committed to protecting the privacy of the people who use our service ("you" or "your").
This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect information when you use CoGrader.
By using CoGrader, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with it,
please do not use our services.
1. Information We Collect
Teacher information: When a teacher creates an account, we collect information such as name, email address, and
school affiliation.
Student information: We do not collect personal information directly from students. Teachers and schools provide
student work to CoGrader, which may include student names or identification codes for grading purposes. We process
this information on behalf of the school, in accordance with FERPA, COPPA, and other applicable laws.
Grading data: Teachers provide assignment questions, rubrics, and student work to CoGrader for grading. This data
may include text, images (such as photos of handwritten work), or other media. We treat this data as education records
under FERPA.
Google user data: When a teacher connects Google Classroom, we access only the data needed to import assignments
and student submissions and to return grades and feedback, such as course lists, assignments, rosters, and
submissions. Our use of this data follows the Google API Services User Data Policy, including its Limited Use
requirements. See our Google API Disclosure.
Usage information: We collect technical information about how you use CoGrader, such as IP address, device
information, browser type, and usage patterns. We use it to operate, secure, and improve the service.
2. How We Use Information
Providing and improving the service: We use teacher and grading data to provide grading and feedback, operate the
service, and keep it secure. We may use aggregated and de-identified data to improve feedback quality and features.
No AI model training: CoGrader does not use customer data, including student work, assignment questions, rubrics,
prompts, or AI outputs, to train, fine-tune, or develop any AI model. Our AI service providers are contractually prohibited
from using this data to train, improve, or develop their models.
Communications: We may use your email address to send service notices, updates, and other relevant information
about CoGrader.
Legal compliance: We may disclose information if the law requires it, or to protect the rights, property, or safety of
CoGrader, our users, or others.
3. Data Security and Retention
Security: We protect information with encryption in transit and at rest, secure storage, access controls, and regular
updates to our security practices. CoGrader holds a SOC 2 Type 1 attestation from an independent auditor.
Data location: CoGrader stores customer data in the United States on Google Cloud Platform.
Retention: We keep personal information only as long as needed for the purposes in this policy, or as the law requires.
We delete data when a teacher or school asks, or when the contract ends, unless the law requires us to keep it.
4. How We Share Information
Service providers: We use trusted service providers to operate CoGrader, such as cloud hosting, data analysis, and
customer support. They receive only the information they need to perform their work, and they must keep it confidential
and secure.
AI service providers: To provide grading and feedback, we share assignment questions, rubrics, and student work with
the AI service providers listed below. We do not send student names or other direct student identifiers to these
providers, except where a teacher includes them in the content itself (for example, a student writes their name in the
essay).

Provider | Service | Purpose |
Google LLC | Gemini, through Google Cloud Vertex AI and Google AI Studio (primary provider) | AI grading and
feedback |
OpenAI OpCo, LLC | OpenAI API | AI grading and feedback |
Microsoft Corporation | Azure AI Foundry | AI grading and feedback |
Anthropic, PBC | Claude, through the Anthropic API | AI grading and feedback |
Each AI service provider processes data only to return results to CoGrader, under a data processing agreement and
terms that prohibit using our data to train their models. Providers may keep a temporary copy of the data for abuse and
safety monitoring (up to 30 days), and then delete it. For more detail, see our AI Transparency Note.
Aggregated data: We may share aggregated and de-identified data for research or statistical purposes. This data does
not identify individuals.
We do not sell personal information.
5. Your Rights and Choices
Access and update: Teachers can access and update their information in their CoGrader account.
Opt out of emails: You can opt out of non-essential emails by following the instructions in those emails.
Deletion: To ask us to delete your information, contact us at the address below. We may need to keep some information
for legal reasons.
Parents and students: Parents and eligible students can ask the school to access, correct, or delete student information.
We help schools respond to these requests.
6. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will give notice of material changes by posting the updated
policy on our website and, where required, by notifying schools and account holders before the changes take effect.
7. Contact Us
If you have questions, concerns, or requests about this Privacy Policy, including data deletion, please contact us at
privacy@cograder.com.
Privacy questions or requests?
If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this policy — including data deletion — write to our privacy team.
privacy@cograder.com

6. Governing Law
These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the state of Delaware, without regard to

7. Changes to Terms
We reserve the right to modify or replace these Terms at any time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting

8. Contact Us
If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding these Terms, please contact us at support@cograder.com.
By using the Cograder service, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these
Terms and any other agreements or policies referenced herein.
CoGrader Fulfillment Policy
Service Delivery
Upon subscription purchase, your CoGrader account will be activated within 24 hours.
Access to CoGrader features will be granted immediately after account activation.
For school and district plans, onboarding sessions will be scheduled within 5 business days of purchase.
Subscription Terms
Individual subscriptions are billed monthly or annually based on your selected plan.
School and district plans are billed annually.
All features included in your subscription tier will be available for the duration of your subscription period.
Refund Policy
If you are not satisfied with CoGrader, you may request a refund within 14 days of initial purchase.
To request a refund, please contact us at support@cograder.com.
Refunds will be processed within 5-7 business days and issued to the original payment method.
After the 14-day period, subscriptions are non-refundable for the current billing cycle.
Cancellation Policy
You may cancel your subscription at any time through your account settings.
For monthly subscriptions, cancellation will take effect at the end of the current billing cycle.
For annual and multiyear subscriptions, cancellation will take effect at the end of the term.
No refunds will be issued for unused portions of the current billing cycle after the 14-day refund period.
Free Trial Terms
Free trials provide full access to CoGrader features for the specified trial period.

No payment information is required to start a free trial.
You will receive an email notification before your trial expires.
If you choose not to subscribe after your trial, your account will be downgraded to limited functionality.
Service Level Agreement
CoGrader aims to maintain 99.9% uptime for our services.
Scheduled maintenance will be announced at least 48 hours in advance.
In the event of unexpected service disruptions, we will communicate updates through our status page.
Account Termination
CoGrader reserves the right to terminate accounts that violate our Terms of Service.
In case of termination due to policy violations, no refunds will be provided.
Users will be notified via email if their account is terminated.
Contact Information
For any questions regarding this Fulfillment Policy, please email us at support@cograder.com.
Questions about these terms?
If anything here is unclear or you need to talk to us about your account, drop us a line.
support@cograder.com

Security Practices
At CoGrader, we take the security of our clients’ and our company’s data very seriously. We believe that it is the
responsibility of every company you trust with your data to secure it according to best practices.
Below is a summary of the precautions we take to protect your data. If you have any questions about our policies, please
write to us at [email protected]
Audit Practices
Last updated 18 June 2024
Overview
CoGrader undergoes security assessments by both internal personnel and our external security firm Agency who
perform regular audits to verify that our security practices are sound and to monitor the services for new vulnerabilities
discovered by the security research community.
Security Controls
Last updated 18 June 2024
CoGrader has implemented and will maintain appropriate measures to protect your data against destruction, loss, or
unauthorized access. The following security controls are in place.
Network Protection
Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR)
Endpoint Management (MDM)
Employee Password Managers
Employee Personal Device Protection
Multi-Factor Authentication
Monitoring & Logging
Last updated 18 June 2024
We understand that even the best software cannot prevent a security incident without 24/7 monitoring. CoGrader
employs Agency to continuously monitor all security systems, maintain forensic logs, and manage incident response.
Dedicated Security Monitoring
Security Logs
Endpoint Logging
Personal Security Policy
Last updated 18 June 2024
Our employees are our first line of defense, and we provide them with the best available resources to protect
themselves, and the data we hold.

24/7 Employee Access to security support
Employee Personal Device Protection
Personal Password Managers
Dark Web Monitoring
Last updated 18 June 2024
CoGrader uses Agency to monitor the dark web on its behalf for exposure of employee passwords.
Dark Web Monitoring
Incident Management
Last updated 18 June 2024
CoGrader maintains security incident management policies and procedures. In the event of an incident, we will notify all
impacted clients, typically by email.
Confidentiality
Last updated 18 June 2024
Confidentiality agreements for all employees
Customer data deleted upon request or termination
Privacy
Last updated 18 June 2024
Complete privacy available here
Business Continuity
Last updated 18 June 2024
Recurring and periodic backups maintained
Infrastructure
Last updated 18 June 2024
At CoGrader we use a variety of third party vendors to support our technology infrastructure and operations. We take the
responsibility of selecting and vetting these vendors extremely seriously.
All infrastructure security fully-vetted
Security assessment performed on all critical-third party vendors
Vendors
Last updated 18 June 2024
We use the following subprocessors to manage certain critical infrastructure for our organization. These have been fully
vetted, and are listed below:

Google Workspace
Slack
Github
Report an Issue
Last updated 18 June 2024
If you believe you've discovered a security-related issue, please contact us at [email protected]
